newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS upgrades Stelco preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: CBRS upgrades Stelco preferred shares.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Monday that it upgraded its rating on Stelco Inc's preferred shares and reaffirmed its ratings on Stelco's debentures and notes.
The rating agency said that it upgraded Stelco's preferred shares to P-3 from P-3 (low).
The steelmaker's retractable debentures and notes were reaffirmed at B++.

CBRS said its ratings decision followed Stelco's "return to profitability last year, the material improvement in its financial and operating performance, stronger balance sheet rations and the repayment of all dividends in arrears."
The rating agency said it also withdrew its rating of Stelco's 7.75 percent convertible subordinated debentures, which were redeemed by the company earlier this year.
